onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2-Basement Trade: 21 6032 Furnace-Gas Replacement 80,000 BTU Remove and replace deteriorated furnace. The furnace knocks on startup and works intermittently. This furnace is at the end of its lifespan. The average life expectancy of a well-maintained furnace is 15 to 20 years. RUUD Furnace installed in 2008 which is nearly 20 years old. Remove and dispose of furnace in legal dump. Install a high efficiency sealed combustion 80,000 BTU, intermittent pilot, gas fired, forced air, furnace with minimum AFUE rating of 92 to existing plenum and gas line. Include set pack controls, PVC venting, and shut-off valve.

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2-Basement Trade: 21 6415 Dryer Vent-GCI Address dryer vent currently exhausting through windowpane opening. Reroute exhaust to closest accessible sill plate Install dryer vent hood to exterior. Repair all tear out. Seal exterior hood to prevent leakage. Install 4" rigid aluminum vent tubing from the specified dryer location to a 4" wall mounted dryer vent hood with a backflow perverter and NO screening. Do not fasten with nails, screws or other fasteners that protrude into the interior of the exhaust duct. Seal all seams in the system with duct mastic or aluminum foil tape, not duct tape. Secure duct and hood to framing.

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 3-Exterior Trade: 1 1602- ADA Deck and Ramp Provide ADA Access ramp to front of property Side A for safe access from front entrance to driveway Side B. Install landing independent of existing structure to service front entrance with handrails to prevent backing and turning hazards. Install steps from new front landing towards driveway and existing sidewalk. Install a maximum running slope of 1: 12 to accommodate a 22" rise. Ramp is to be a minimum of 36" in width with railings on both sides. Top of gripping rails shall be 34" minimum and 38" maximum above ramp surface. Clearance between handrail and railing surface shall be a minimum of 1 1/2". Walking surface shall be slip resistant. Ramp may need to have two runs 90 degrees to each other to reach driveway. Ramps that change direction between runs at landings shall have a clear landing 60" by 60" minimum. The bottom of the ramp will terminate on the driveway area. Existing concrete step unit will need to be removed before construction of ramp system.

Location: 3-Exterior Trade: 10 2640 Siding-Vinyl The siding has proven to be effective for the life of this siding. Aluminum siding typically lasts 30 to 50 years and this siding is 70 years old. There is minimal physical damage, but after 70 years, the original factory finish has oxidized into a chalky residue making it difficult for paint to bond. Mid-century siding was not designed with proper backing or weather barriers. Older installation methods lacked proper flashing which can trap moisture. Remove and replace existing aluminum siding with vinyl siding including all cornice, corner, door and window trim after replacing all deteriorated exterior building components. Wrap home with 1/4" permeable rigid fanfold insulation as a paint barrier and substrate for siding materials. Apply owner's choice of siding color, exposure and texture with a manufacturer warranty. Include all electrical and plumbing blocks. Remove and reinstall awning Side C entrance. Caulk all joints and seams. ***NOTE: PLEASE BE CAREFUL WHEN WORKING AROUND BUSHES AND PLANTS ...

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 3-Exterior Trade:15 4580 Tear off and reroof shingles Address aged and deteriorating roof. 3-tab shingles showing signs of wear with missing and deteriorating asphalt. Remove roof to deck, if sheathing is not a stable substrate, apply for a change order to correct. Sheathing must be installed and fastened to the structure in accordance with IRC Code. Install 15 lb felt,ice and damn shield underlayment where required, self self-sealing, 25 Year laminated architectural shingle. Replace all flashing.including valleys and roof edge. Flash and counter flash chimneys. Kick out flashing where flashing terminates at side walls. Color choice by owner. Venting as required by ICC code. Install shingle-over ridge vent. Clean and dispose of all exterior debris generated by the tear off and replacement of the roof. All work is to be completed to current International Residentiail Building Code.
